name: Detect Guest Value
summary: Records that an active guest interaction has produced value worth preserving.

preconditions.expression: guest-identity == active and claimable-value == none and durable-identity == absent

setup: Create an active guest interaction with no existing claimable-value state.

inputs.description: Reference to the conversation, artifact, or other guest-created value.

postconditions.expression: guest-identity == active and claimable-value == detected and durable-identity == absent
